entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: An artificial metal plane created and shaped by Memnarch.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Creator and keeper of Mirrodin's myr, who shared power with the vedalken and who found madness in the blur between metal and flesh.

entities.name: Ushanti
entities.description: A leonin shaman who has seen a future in which all leonin are torn from the world.

entities.name: Bruenna
entities.description: A Neurok leader.

entities.name: Pontifex
entities.description: A vedalken elder researcher.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: Keeper of the Vault.

entities.name: Slobad
entities.description: A goblin tinkerer, remembered by Glissa as someone who never laughed.

entities.name: Korva
entities.description: A Vulshok battlemaster.

entities.name: Durg
entities.description: A goblin archaeologist, easily impressed.

entities.name: Glissa Sunseeker
entities.description: An elf who knew Slobad.

entities.name: Tel-Jilad
entities.description: Home of the trolls, protected by them and by creatures of the Tangle.

entities.name: The Tangle
entities.description: Mirrodin's forest.

entities.name: Mephidross
entities.description: A corrosive region claiming all life within it.

entities.name: Darksteel Citadel
entities.description: Forge of the Darksteel Eye, home of Mirrodin's keeper.

entities.name: Nim
entities.description: Mirrodin's undead.

entities.name: Vedalken
entities.description: Knowledge-seeking people who received a touch of Memnarch's power in return for service.

entities.name: Leonin
entities.description: Feline people of Mirrodin.

entities.name: Auriok
entities.description: Humans who have long fought the metal hordes.

entities.name: Myr
entities.description: Creatures created by Memnarch for dependability, controllability and disposability.

entities.name: Ur-Golem
entities.description: Ancient golem whose eye was separated from its body by Memnarch.

events.summary: Ushanti recounts a vision of the end of times in which all leonin are torn from the world.
events.quote: I have seen the end of times, a future in which all our kind are torn from this world.

events.summary: Memnarch grants the vedalken a touch of his power in exchange for service, creating a debt.
events.quote: Memnarch shared a touch of his power with the vedalken in return for their service.

events.summary: Memnarch created the myr with dependability, controllability and disposability in mind.
events.quote: Memnarch created the myr with three qualities in mind: dependability, controllability, and disposability.

events.summary: Memnarch finds madness between metal and flesh.
events.quote: In the blur between metal and flesh, Memnarch found madness.

events.summary: Memnarch separated the Ur-Golem's eye from its body millennia ago.
events.quote: It still stares accusingly at Memnarch, though millennia have passed since he separated the eye from its body.

events.summary: Memnarch escalates the stakes when civilizations develop ways to fight the levelers.
events.quote: When Mirrodin's varied civilizations developed ways to fight the levelers, Memnarch upped the stakes.

events.summary: Mirrodin begins to take on a life of its own through Memnarch's work.
events.quote: In bringing life to Mirrodin, Memnarch was more successful than he knew—for Mirrodin began to take on a life of its own.

events.summary: Memnarch is quoted on the equilibrium of his experimental myr population.
events.quote: As the experimental population grows, so do the number of myr. It's a perfect equilibrium.

events.summary: Glissa Sunseeker recalls Slobad as seemingly exiled for being too smart.
events.quote: I used to joke that he had been exiled for being too smart.

events.summary: Slobad wonders what kind of ogre approaches.
events.quote: Is it the stomping kind or the munching kind?

events.summary: Durg is about to be blown away.
events.quote: Always easily impressed, Durg was about to be blown away.
